final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only adservice showed restart outlier: pod adservice-d6c9fcc6b-d4nlb on worker-02 had RESTARTS 2 (30s ago) while all other 10 boutique services had 0. Pod detail: Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 143 (kubelet SIGTERM, not OOM 137), with events 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.163:9555/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP status code "\x00\x00\x00\x04\b..."' (x9) and 'Killing: Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3). GetAppYAML(adservice) shows the mismatch: readinessProbe correctly uses grpc port 9555, but livenessProbe uses httpGet path=/ port=9555 against the same gRPC/HTTP2-only port. Server logs confirm the protocol conflict from the app side: 'io.netty.handler.codec.http2.Http2Exception: Unexpected HTTP/1.x request: GET /' at Http2ConnectionHandler$PrefaceDecoder.readClientPrefaceString. The container itself is healthy (Ready True, ContainersReady True, port 9555/TCP), so the liveness probe can never succeed, causing repeated kubelet kills and the restart loop. No metric alerts were active, ruling out resource-pressure causes.

      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:

              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

        ports:
        - containerPort: 9555
        env:

        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 180Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 300Mi

            port: 9555

          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 9555
